module: Data model of the rally editor's "AI Competitors" tab. It reads and writes the JSON file gameplay/rally/aiCompetitorsConfig.json (sections general, competitors, ui), provides the default values of the 26 general parameters of the result mixture model (Safe, Push, Minor Mistake, Major Issue, DNF) and of 5 competitors (A to E, skill/consistency/risk traits at 0.5), the slider bounds, value formatting and the parameter groups shown in the UI. The mixture computations come from gameplay/rally/aiCompetitors, re-exposed here (computeMixtureWeights, mixtureDensityTimes).
notes: A competitor's traits (skill, consistency, risk) are clamped to [0, 1]; if any of the three values exceeds 1, all three are divided by 100 (0-100 scale accepted). Strings are converted with tonumber (0.5 otherwise).
On read, the competitors list is taken from raw.competitors, otherwise raw.drivers, otherwise the A to E preset.
Only keys known to defaultGeneral are accepted in mergeGeneral; the others are ignored.
On write, numbers are rounded to 3 decimals (nearly integer values become integers).
The ui.rng_seed field is nil by default, so it does not appear in defaultUiDict.

outcomeDnf.desc: Index (5) of the DNF / Terminal outcome.

outcomeLabels.desc: Labels: Safe / Clean, Push / Aggressive, Minor Mistake, Major Issue, DNF / Terminal.

generalSliderBounds.desc: Slider min/max bounds for each general parameter.

generalFieldNames.desc: Names of the general parameters, sorted alphabetically.

generalParamGroups.desc: Display groups {title, blurb, fields}: Stage limits, Safe & Push, Incidents & DNF, Pace vs reference, Base std dev, Consistency on std dev.

mergeGeneral.desc: Returns a copy of the default general parameters, overridden by the known, non-nil keys of overrides.

defaultUiDict.desc: Returns the default UI settings: default_player_time_sec 100, default_appearance_mode "dark", default_color_theme "blue", window_min_width 1100, window_min_height 720, slider_min 0, slider_max 1, default_slider_value 0.5.

configWithDefaults.desc: Completes a raw configuration with default values: merged general, normalized competitors (traits in [0,1]), merged ui.

raw.desc: Configuration read (general, competitors or drivers, ui).

loadRawConfig.desc: Reads configPath with jsonReadFile; returns an empty table if the file is missing or invalid.

saveConfig.desc: Writes {general, competitors, ui} (numbers rounded to 3 decimals) to configPath with jsonWriteFile (pretty format).

clampParamToSliderRange.desc: Clamps a value to the parameter's slider range (unchanged if the parameter is unknown).

formatParamValue.desc: Formats a parameter according to its magnitude: 2 decimals if |v| ≥ 100, 3 if ≥ 10, 4 if ≥ 1, otherwise 5 significant digits.

fieldLabel.desc: Turns a snake_case name into a label (e.g. "risk_tail_exponent" gives "Risk Tail Exponent").

sliderToUnit.desc: Converts a slider value to [0, 1]; if the span is ≤ 0, simply clamps the value.
